name: reads-and-says-nothing
about: The model reads four tools, narrates what it would do, and emits no write call at all. Observed live on 2026-09-11 and the reason `defineTool.taskClasses` exists — it is the documented failure mode at the top of the 10-30 tool band. The shape assertion here is `proposalChanges: 0` with `toolCalls` non-empty, which is precisely the signature KI-11 says to read the per-turn record for.

source.from: the 2026-09-11 live planning turn (defineTool's taskClasses note)

question: plan me a six day trip to Kyoto

content.text: I would add three stops to day 1 and spread the rest across days 2 and 3. Shall I?
